title: ZC Labs Buy Up Mesa Gold Mines
author: The Tribune
pages: The ZC Lab near Chonksalma always had a good relationship with the nearby mesa gold mines. Mesa gold mines sold massive quantities of gold with the money that ZC Labs earned from curing potions.
ZC Labs turned sick people and gold into healthy people and profit.
However, this relationship appeared to not be enough for this ZC Lab, which recently bought many of its gold mine trading partners.
They put out a statement, proclaiming this purchase as a victory for patients, since they can now guarantee that the gold from these mines goes to cure production.

However, critics state that this only increases the profits for this ZC Lab, and makes it far more difficult for anyone else to manufacture curies. There are already concerns about high cure prices, and the lack of competition may worsen it in the long run.
